label: 1_max_temp_spat_cont_orig
description:
Maximum temporal and spatial contiguity condition (reordering of the original
  4x4 design). Kachergis, Yu, & Shiffrin (2009). Temporal contiguity in
  cross-situational statistical learning. Proceedings of the 31st Annual Meeting
  of the Cognitive Science Society.

label: 4_no_spat_orig_max_tc
description:
Maximum temporal contiguity without spatial contiguity -- same training order
  as 1_max_temp_spat_cont_orig, but referent screen positions were not held
  contiguous. Kachergis, Yu, & Shiffrin (2009). Temporal contiguity in
  cross-situational statistical learning. Proceedings of the 31st Annual Meeting
  of the Cognitive Science Society.

label: 1olap3tr_contr
description: Kachergis, G., Yu, C., & Shiffrin, R. M. (2009). Temporal contiguity in cross-situational statistical learning. Proceedings of the 31st Annual Meeting of the Cognitive Science Society. 4 words and 4 objects per training trial (symmetric design), 27 trials, 18-word vocabulary -- a reordering of the original 4x4 schedule manipulating how many trials separate a pair's repeated co-occurrences (temporal contiguity). This condition: 1 overlap per 3 trials, contr (control order). See data-raw/add_temporal_contiguity_overlap.R.
